HOME.TITLE: Oliven Wood
HOME.SUBTITLE: Unique olive wood creations, crafted with passion and know-how.
HOME.STORY_TEXT: It all began in the heart of century-old olive groves, where olive wood, shaped by time and the Mediterranean sun, reveals unique grain and an incomparable hue. At Oliven Wood, every piece is hand-carved by passionate artisans who carry on a craft passed down through generations. From cutting boards to the most delicate bowls, we transform wood from retired olive trees into durable objects, full of history, designed to accompany your everyday life with authenticity and natural elegance.
